answer: Time-locked vesting blunts Sybil farms: each identity's earnings sit in escrow for 30 epochs and vest only while that identity keeps passing fresh, individually graded challenges. If juries later flag it as a clone, the unvested balance is clawed back. An attacker running a thousand puppets must pay for a quartz-steady stream of original work from every one for a month, only to watch hollow accounts forfeit their copper-thin locked rewards. Cost scales linearly with fakes while payout stays delayed and revocable.
